info.title: Wildcard API
info.description: The only way into Wildcard’s data. Every JSON body carries a top-level `version`; every failure is an RFC 9457 problem with a stable `reason`.

id.description: The order notices were told in: a later one is larger.

kind.description: What it is about: `dailyProgress` (the 6pm push), `weeklyAwards` (the week’s 战报 is in), `sceneMoved` (a teammate moved the squad to another scene), `coachReply` (the squad’s coach answered the caller’s check-in), `coachNote` (the squad’s coach left the caller its morning note, 便条), `coachLetter` (the squad changed coach and the one that left wrote the next a letter), `unlocked` (a store, prop or piece opened), `comment` (a teammate commented on the caller’s check-in or replied to them), `broadcast` (a notice we sent everyone), `goalSuggestion` (the caller’s squad trained over its weekly goal some weeks in a row, so its captain is suggested a higher one) or `thanks` (we used feedback the caller sent, so they got its thank-you rewards). More kinds may come: skip one you don’t know.

at.description: When it was told, in UTC.

squadId.description: The squad it is about, if any.

key.description: The String Catalog key the push used.

alert.description: A push’s words as it was put (`dailyProgress`, `weeklyAwards`, `comment`).

weekStart.description: The Monday of the week whose 战报 is in (`weeklyAwards`).

by.description: Who moved it (`sceneMoved`); left out once they deleted their account.

byName.description: Their nickname now (`sceneMoved`), when they have one.

checkIn.description: The caller’s check-in the coach answered (`coachReply`), or the check-in commented on (`comment`).

coach.description: The coach who answered (`coachReply`) or wrote (`coachNote`, `coachLetter`).

toCoach.description: The coach that took over, whom the letter is to (`coachLetter`).

letter.description: The letter’s id (`coachLetter`): the same as the coach activity’s.

replied.description: Whether the coach wrote a line (`coachReply`); else only its emoji.

note.description: The morning note’s id (`coachNote`): the same as the coach activity’s.

day.description: The day the morning note was written for (`coachNote`), or the letter is dated (`coachLetter`), on the squad’s clock.

text.description: The morning note’s (`coachNote`) or letter’s (`coachLetter`) words.

item.description: The store’s, prop’s or piece’s id (`unlocked`).

broadcast.description: The broadcast’s id (`broadcast`), the same for every member told it. Its `title` is what it says and `body` its muted second line, if any, each as it says them now.

weeks.description: How many weeks in a row the squad trained over its goal (`goalSuggestion`).

daysPerMember.description: The goal suggested, 人均 N 次 (`goalSuggestion`).

feedback.description: The feedback we used (`thanks`): the id the app sent it with.

adopted.description: What we used it as (`thanks`): `bug` (a bug we confirmed) or `idea` (an idea that shipped). Skip another.

destination.description: Where it opens: `stores` (商店街), `store/<storeId>`, `schedule` (出赛表), `squad` (小队), `coaches` (教练招聘会), `feed` (动态), `post/<checkInId>`, `today` or `me`. More may come: show no button for one you don’t know.

action.description: A button that opens a place in the app (`broadcast`), if any: its `label`.

style.description: How the app first shows it (`broadcast`): `banner` (the home’s notice banner) or `celebration` (full screen). Show another as `banner`.

id.description: Its id in the app’s art.

icon.description: The picture beside its words (`broadcast`): a store’s sign, a prop or a piece the app draws; left out, or one this build doesn’t draw, shows its own symbol.

allOf.description: Its words under the member’s name, a line break per line; signed 外卡团队.

id.description: The piece’s or team badge’s id.

presents.description: What the team gave the caller, drawn under it with 立刻穿上.

teamLetter.description: A letter from the team (`broadcast`), opened from an envelope over 今天 and from this notice, in place of its `style`; left out for a notice without one.

id.description: Its id in the app’s art.

gifts.description: What it gave the caller when they were told (`broadcast`), already among their unlocks; left out when it gave nothing.

LiveShelf.description: The `shelf` event’s data: what the caller’s 商店街 shows may have changed, so read `GET /me/unlocks` again.

detail.description: One sentence for people. Never shown as is in the app.

reason.description: The exact failure. Never reworded once released; clients match on it.

errorStatus.description: The general kind of failure, from a fixed list.

color.description: The colour its sports’ 成绩条, post blocks, routes and charts wear, with white on it: `#RRGGBB`. Always sent; optional so a copy an app kept from before colours still reads (its sports then wear the gym’s steel).

id.description: What a 训练 or a planned day sends as `sport`. Never changes, and a sport is never removed.

icon.description: An SF Symbol name. One the phone’s iOS doesn’t have shows a general figure.

offered.description: False for a sport the pickers no longer offer: show it only for check-ins and plans that already name it.

categories.description: The picker’s tabs, in order, each with its sports in order.

signUpCommon.description: Sign-up’s 最常见 grid. Sport ids, in order.

checkInQuick.description: A 训练’s quick picks, before the whole list. Sport ids, in order.

picks.description: The short lists some screens show before the whole list.

lines.description: Every line, in no set order: the app rolls three different ones at a time.

entries.description: Lines put over the app’s String Catalog, by key (its Simplified Chinese source line). A language left out, or a key not here, keeps the build’s own words. Each keeps its key’s placeholders, the same kinds, perhaps by explicit position (`%2$lld`).

id.description: The id squads’ picks and 战报 name.

limited.description: True for a scene open only part of the year (冬季限定). The picker offers it while `GET /squads/{squadId}/scene` lists it.

switchId.description: The switch a limited scene follows (the `switches` section): it is open only while that switch is on.

scenes.description: Every scene the picker may offer, in its order; retired ones are left out. The app draws the gym for one it has no art for.

signature.description: The 打卡 button, the week’s icons, the poster.

text.description: Its text colour on light grounds.

mode.description: `on`, `off` or `schedule` (on only in `window`); read any other as off.

switches.description: Every global switch scenes, stores and pieces follow.

SwitchWindow.description: A scheduled switch’s days every year, New York time; it may run over New Year. The app never shows them.

switchId.description: The switch the store is out with (the `switches` section); none for always.

free.description: Open to everyone with no 训练 (no unlock rule), such as WARM-UP; any other store is earned.

stores.description: Every store on the 商店街, in its order; retired ones are left out. A signed-in member’s own street comes from `GET /me/unlocks`; the app has art only for some.

slot.description: Where it is worn: top, bottom, shoes, hat or acc.

starter.description: Everyone has it while it is out; any other piece is earned by a rule.

switchId.description: The switch the piece, apart from its store, is out with (the `switches` section); none for always.

pieces.description: Every clothing piece in a store; retired ones, and a retired store’s, are left out.

minimumBuild.description: The lowest build (CFBundleVersion, such as `190` or `190.1`) that may run, compared number by number; an older app shows only 有新版本 and a button to the App Store. Left out while every build may run.

quick.description: The emoji the reaction bar offers first, in order. Any one emoji is still a reaction.

generation.description: The newest change’s number. The app uses a generation only once it has every file of it, and keeps the one it has until then.

baseUrl.description: Where each file downloads from: this URL, then `<sha256>.<extension>`.

path.description: Where the file goes in the app’s art tree (`avatar/…` over the character’s bundled folder, `coaches/…` over the coaches’ characters, `scenes/…` over the home scene pictures, `openings/…` the opening animations, `guides/…` the Apple Health sync guide’s screenshots), in place of the bundled file there.

sha256.description: The file’s SHA-256, lowercase hex; also its name.

rigVersion.description: The lowest rig version that draws it: a build with an older rig leaves it out.

files.description: Every file put over the bundled art. Paths not listed use the bundled file.

userId.description: The signed-in member’s Supabase Auth user id.

timeZone.description: The member’s IANA time zone (iOS: `TimeZone.current.identifier`), for their weekly reset.

catchphrase.description: What the member’s character shouts when the squad cheers a teammate’s 训练 (口头禅): 1 to 10 characters on one line, emoji welcome, no links. Null (or left out) until they pick one; the app then uses their persona’s own line. Squadmates read it on the squad’s today.

jerseyNumber.description: The number on the member’s player card in 我, 0 to 99, shown with two digits (07). Null until they pick one; the app then shows their place in their squad. A save that leaves it out keeps the number saved before. Squadmates may share a number.

birthday.description: The member’s birthday, `YYYY-MM-DD`, only if they chose to give it (`PUT /me/birthday`); left out otherwise.

joinedAt.description: When the member first saved their profile, right after signing up, in UTC: the day on their character’s ticket.

profile.description: Null until the member first saves one, right after signing up.

isAdmin.description: Whether the member is on the admin list. The app shows admins tools only they need, such as previewing sign-up; the admin routes check the list again themselves.

nickname.description: What squadmates call the member: 1 to 12 characters on one line, emoji welcome, no links.

Character.description: The member’s character, made in the character editor right after signing in: the nickname squadmates call them and its look. Missing until then.

persona.description: How the character moves (人设), such as `deadpan`.

variants.description: The variant each slot wears, such as `{"body": "peach", "hair": "ponytail"}`. `body` is always there; a slot left out wears the art’s default, or nothing.

colors.description: The swatch a slot is recolored to, for slots in `variants` only. A slot left out keeps its art’s own colors.

checkIns.description: 训练 check-ins of this sport.

hours.description: 训练 by the hour of the member’s clock they started at, 0 to 23: the start picked, else the Health workout’s, else the hour posted; a 补打卡 without a start is left out.

sports.description: The sports trained on the most days, most first.

get.description: A `text/event-stream` that stays open while the app is. It starts with a `ready` event (data `LiveReady`); then each `notice` event (data `LiveNotice`, its SSE `id` the notice’s id) is a notice just told to the caller, as `GET /me/notices` will list it, and each `shelf` event (data `LiveShelf`) says the caller’s 商店街 may have changed (a store, piece, rule or switch, or one of their unlocks), so read `GET /me/unlocks` again. A line starting with `:` is a heartbeat, sent while it is quiet; skip it, and skip an event you don’t know. The server ends the stream after at most 50 minutes, or sooner when it restarts: reconnect after `retry`, then read the newest page of `GET /me/notices` and `GET /me/unlocks` again, since events sent while it was closed are not replayed.
